entry.content:
vulnerability · insufficient-entropy · CVE-2026-71851

CryptoJS library versions containing `WordArray.random()` suffer from insufficient entropy in cryptographic secret generation, producing only ~2^39 bits of effective entropy for 128-bit requests and ~2^47 for 256-bit requests instead of the full keyspace. This vulnerability is critical as it allows attackers to enumerate possible cryptographic secrets on commodity hardware, and is exploited in the wild with downstream wallet applications using the function for BIP39 recovery phrase generation. Immediate action required: update CryptoJS to a patched version and audit any applications using this library for key generation, particularly cryptocurrency wallets and sensitive credential systems, regenerating compromised secrets.

entry.title: After the Break-In: What Attackers Do Once They're Already Inside
entry.content:
red-team · post-exploitation

This article examines post-compromise attacker behavior rather than a specific vulnerability, focusing on persistence mechanisms, defense evasion, and lateral movement tactics observed during real intrusions. The analysis demonstrates that attackers systematically disable security controls, establish backdoors, and modify system configurations to maintain access—highlighting why incident response must address root cause rather than just removing detected malware. While not describing a specific exploitable vulnerability, the techniques discussed are widely employed in active intrusions and present high severity due to their ability to undermine remediation efforts. Defenders should implement continuous monitoring of system changes, prioritize investigation of initial compromise vectors, maintain immutable audit logs, and ensure comprehensive artifact analysis during incident response rather than focusing solely on malware removal.

entry.title: Hackers Exploit AnySign4PC via Hacked Korean Sites to Install Backdoors Without Prompts
entry.content:
vulnerability · rce

AnySign4PC, a Korean financial-security software, contains a vulnerability allowing remote code execution without user prompts when visiting compromised websites. The exploit is part of a state-sponsored campaign attributed to North Korean threat actors targeting South Korean users through watering-hole attacks on trusted domestic sites, delivering SIGNBT and COPPERHEDGE backdoors. Severity is high given the lack of user interaction required and active exploitation in the wild. Affected organizations should immediately patch AnySign4PC to the latest version and implement network-level controls to restrict access to compromised sites.

entry.title: Azure Cosmos DB Flaw Exposed Platform-Wide Key That Could Access Any Database
entry.content:
vulnerability · sandbox-escape,rce,privilege-escalation

Azure Cosmos DB contained a sandbox escape vulnerability in the Gremlin query engine that allowed attackers to execute arbitrary code and obtain platform-wide master keys granting read/write access across all customer databases and tenants. The vulnerability, designated CosmosEscape by Wiz researchers, was triggered through specially crafted Gremlin queries and could have compromised the entire multi-tenant platform. Microsoft has patched the flaw; customers should verify patches are applied and review access logs for potential exploitation. No evidence of exploitation in the wild was reported at the time of disclosure.

entry.title: prebid-server's request forgery vulnerability allows for possible host environment data extraction (CVE-2026-54735)
entry.content:
vulnerability · ssrf · CVE-2026-54725, CVE-2026-54735

Prebid Server bidder adapters contain a request forgery vulnerability (CVE-2026-54735) where user-supplied parameters are interpolated into outbound URLs without proper validation, allowing attackers to redirect HTTP requests to unintended destinations and potentially access internal network services or sensitive endpoints. This critical-severity flaw affects versions prior to v4.4.0 across all major version branches (v1-v4). The vulnerability enables Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks that could expose host environment data or internal services. Immediately upgrade to Prebid Server v4.4.0 or later; no workaround is mentioned for users unable to patch immediately.

entry.title: Logging operator has Fluentd configuration injection that allows remote code execution (CVE-2026-54680)
entry.content:
vulnerability · config-injection · CVE-2026-54680

The Logging operator for Kubernetes (github.com/kube-logging/logging-operator) contains a critical configuration injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-54680) where the Fluentd configuration renderer fails to escape strings from CRD resources, allowing any user who can create Flow resources to inject arbitrary Fluentd configuration. An attacker can exploit this by injecting newlines into fields like `record_transformer.records` to close configuration blocks and inject a `` block with Fluentd's `@type exec` plugin, achieving remote code execution. This vulnerability is critical and should be patched immediately; apply the latest security update to the Logging operator and restrict RBAC permissions for Flow resource creation to trusted users only.
